criteria.text: The board shows every recorded grout batch in one list on the page.
criteria.note: Every batch is there in one list right under the header — B-1041, B-1042 and B-1043, one line each.

criteria.text: A new batch can be added from the board itself, without leaving the page.
criteria.note: The add row is on the board: a 'new batch code' input with an ADD BATCH button beside it, no navigation away.

criteria.text: The board names itself in a header so the tiler knows what he is looking at.
criteria.note: An orange band across the top reads GROUT TRACKER, just as the drawing has it (rgb(224,138,60)).

criteria.text: The batch list is the first thing under the header.
criteria.note: The list sits directly beneath the header — the header ends at y=51 and the list starts at y=71, nothing between them.

criteria.text: An ADD BATCH button sits to the right of the input.
criteria.note: The ADD BATCH button is to the right of the input: the input runs to x=1283 and the button starts at x=1293, sharing the same row.

criteria.text: A status line beneath the add row shows the current mix ratio.
criteria.note: Your drawing has a mix-ratio line in orange beneath the add row; it isn't there at all — below the add row the page goes straight to the footer.
No screen surface for this, but your own tests cover it and they pass.

criteria.text: The export writes valid CSV with a header row.
criteria.note: I could not check this. It has no screen surface, and your test run (which passed) only covers rendering the header and surviving a restart — nothing in it speaks to the CSV export.

gaps.title: the mix-ratio status line
gaps.expected: a status line in orange beneath the add row, showing the current mix ratio and how many batches are open
gaps.saw: nothing there — below the add row the page goes straight to the footer

alsoChecked: The ADD BATCH button is teal (rgb(90,166,184)); the drawing says the button colour is the builder's call, so that's fine.
There's a footer reading 'grout tracker · sandbox build'; the drawing is silent on a footer, so that's the builder's call, not a fault.
summary: Captain, the board runs and reads well: the orange GROUT TRACKER header is up top, all three batches sit in one list directly beneath it, and the add row has its input with ADD BATCH to the right — all three of your PRD goals are met, and your own tests confirm batches survive a restart. The one real miss is the status line: your drawing puts a mix-ratio line beneath the add row, but it's absent here — the page drops straight to the footer. And the CSV export I couldn't verify, since it has no screen surface and your test suite doesn't cover it.
